name: Periapt of Wound Closure

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: You stabilize at the start of your turn when dying, and Hit Point Dice you spend heal twice as much.
text: If you start your turn dying while wearing this pendant, you automatically stabilize. Also, each Hit Point Die you roll to regain Hit Points restores twice the usual amount.
